name: Menefeeceratops
sum: Menefeeceratops is the oldest known centrosaurine, from the early Campanian Menefee Formation of New Mexico.
wsnote: Estimated by comparison with Styracosaurus, Vagaceratops and Centrosaurus (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: NMMNH P-25052, a fragmentary skull, mandible, vertebrae, ribs, left ilium and limb elements found by Paul Sealey in 1996 — Allison Member, Menefee Formation, Sandoval County, New Mexico.
biology: Known from a partial skeleton; no behavioural data.
author: Dalman et al. 2021
